extracted.intended_audience: PR/communications professionals, video producers, and TV newsroom editors receiving/distributing VNRs
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and checklist for producing Video News Releases (VNRs) intended to look like news segments and to be distributed to TV stations and digital outlets. Covers content/format, technical specs, standard components, distribution channels, labeling/sponsorship, recall-specific guidance, and modern digital/social variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: No dissolves or fancy effects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use straightforward footage without stylistic transitions so stations can easily edit and integrate the segment into broadcasts; avoid anything that looks like commercial post-production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Straightforward footage for station editing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shoot and assemble footage in a way that allows local newsrooms to cut, reframe, or rearrange elements quickly without heavy re-editing; keep clips simple and clean.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length: 5 to 7.5 minutes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce a full-package VNR in the 5–7.5 minute range (the commonly accepted broadcast package length); shorter 'handles' or cutdowns may be provided separately for multiple uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Longer 'handles' on shot ends
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leave extra frames at the start/end of shots to allow stations to create transitions and to accommodate timing adjustments; don't trim too tightly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Split audio tracks for editor flexibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Split audio tracks for editor flexibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide separate audio stems (e.g., music, dialogue, nat sound) so stations can lower music, swap audio, or mix sound bites as needed for their broadcast standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimal color correction (broadcast legal)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform only necessary color correction to meet broadcast legal limits and avoid stylized grading that would hinder local matching or make footage look non-broadcast.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard NTSC/PAL specifications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliver video conforming to the broadcast standards used by target stations (frame rate, resolution, encoding, and other specs) to ensure compatability and avoid playback issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple aspect ratios provided
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply versions in common broadcast and legacy aspect ratios (e.g., 16:9 and 4:3) so stations with different formats can use the material without awkward cropping or letterboxing.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality audio (separate music/dialogue)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record and deliver broadcast-quality audio; separate music and dialogue tracks to preserve clarity and give stations mixing control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scripted narration included
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a polished scripted narration track or script that stations can use as a voiceover; keeping it scripted helps ensure consistent messaging and easy pickup by anchors.

rubrics_metrics.name: B-roll footage for station use
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include ample, well-labeled B-roll segments that local stations can repurpose, with clear handles and varied coverage to support different story edits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interviews with designated experts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Film clear, on-camera interviews with identified subject-matter experts who can speak credibly; include multiple angles and tight/medium shots for cutaways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suggested anchor lead-ins
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide text for anchor introductions/lead-ins so stations know how to introduce the VNR segment; supply brief suggested copy that fits local broadcast tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lower-third graphics templates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include editable lower-third graphics or templates that stations can use to identify speakers and provide context, reducing the need for stations to create their own graphics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closing tags
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add a closing tag (credit or contact tag) identifying the source or providing additional information; ensure it is concise and broadcast-friendly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ready for air with minimal editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Ready for air with minimal editing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble the package so that a station can air it with minimal additional production—clearly labeled elements, quality-controlled audio/video, and standard formatting help meet this goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution via standard channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Satellite feeds (C-band traditional); Now: digital downloads from PR distribution sites; Continuous loop feeds for stations to capture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer multiple delivery options familiar to stations—satellite feeds, continuous loop feeds, and digital download/distribution services—to maximize pickup and accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship identification requirements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with legal/regulatory requirements for disclosing sponsorship (federal scrutiny since early 2000s); clearly label who produced or funded the VNR to avoid deceptive practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stations should disclose VNR origin
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Best practice/advocated standard: stations that air VNR material should disclose its origin (e.g., produced by X firm/agency) so viewers know the source of content.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPSC recall VNR: clear product identification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For recall-related VNRs, clearly identify the product involved to ensure viewers immediately recognize the item being recalled.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPSC recall VNR: specific safety hazard
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spell out the specific safety hazard or defect being addressed so consumers understand the risk and severity.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPSC recall VNR: consumer actions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide explicit, actionable instructions for consumers (e.g., stop using, check serial numbers, return to store) so viewers know exactly what to do.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPSC recall VNR: refund/repair process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how affected consumers can obtain refunds, repairs, or replacements, including steps and any necessary documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPSC recall VNR: contact information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give clear contact details (phone, website, email) for consumers seeking more information or assistance regarding the recall.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide multiple shots/angles for editor choice
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture several angles, close-ups, and wide shots so editors have options for pacing and storytelling; this increases the likelihood of station usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear audio and clean sound bites
rubrics_metrics.description: Clear audio (split tracks); Sound bites in clean format
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure interview sound bites are recorded without background noise and are edited/marked cleanly; separate tracks improve clarity and mixing at the station end.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-resolution / broadcast quality video
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliver video at broadcast-quality resolution and bitrate expected by stations to avoid rejection or additional processing; include master files and lower-bitrate deliverables as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Captioning / transcripts provided
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply closed captions and/or full transcripts to meet accessibility requirements and make repurposing for web and social easier.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject expert visible/quoted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature on-camera experts or quoted authorities to increase credibility; identify affiliations and credentials in provided graphics or scripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story arc (beginning, middle, end)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure the VNR with a clear narrative arc—intro, development, and conclusion—to emulate a news story and make it usable without heavy rewrites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Web-ready short cuts (60 seconds)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce short (≈60s) cutdowns optimized for web and social sharing in addition to the full package for broadcasters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media formats (vertical, square)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide versions formatted for social platforms (vertical, square) to increase reach and ensure correct display on mobile-first channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embeddable players
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer embeddable video players or easily embed-capable files for distribution on websites and partner pages to facilitate online pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple language tracks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include language variants or separate audio tracks to serve multilingual markets and to facilitate translation/adaptation by stations.

rubrics_metrics.name: YouTube optimization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare assets (thumbnails, metadata, caption files, proper aspect ratios and lengths) optimized for YouTube to maximize discoverability and compliance with platform norms.
